title: Tooling: 2.03× faster parity-side basis/contains with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, the historical parity-side audit spends most time in `scripts/binary_phase_frames.py`: `basis` and `contains` are called millions of times, and `contains` previously rebuilt `basis(space)` twice per membership test.

This PR memoizes `basis` on the row tuple and implements `contains` by reducing the vector against one basis of the space. The highest-bit pivot rule, elimination order, classify/nullspace/residual APIs and every Boolean result are unchanged. Only the source pin for `scripts/binary_phase_frames.py` changes inside the three certificates that bind that file (`parity-side`, `disjoint-tensor-compression`, `dyadic-central-factor`).

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3, five alternating fresh-process pairs of the full `h=8,10,26` stream gave median **27.349 → 13.463 s (2.03×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every experiment receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise.

Package: `research/parity-side-basis-cache/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/parity-side-basis-cache/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/parity-side-basis-cache/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/parity-side-basis-cache
python3.12 -I -B research/parity-side-basis-cache/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PARITY_SIDE_BASIS_CACHE h=[8, 10, 26] roles=[724, 2271, 82720] repaired=[938, 3283, 308336] ... no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/parity-side-basis-cache outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_PARITY_SIDE_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

No competing open PR on this object at refresh.
